expo.name: RecipeGenie

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RecipeGenie needs access to your photo library so you can upload photos of your ingredients to generate recipes.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RecipeGenie needs access to your camera so you can take photos of your ingredients to generate recipes.

plugins.photosPermission: RecipeGenie needs access to your photos so you can upload ingredient images to generate recipes.
plugins.cameraPermission: RecipeGenie needs access to your camera so you can take photos of your ingredients to generate recipes.

expo.description: Transform your fridge ingredients into delicious meals with AI-powered recipe generation! Features include photo ingredient recognition, dietary preferences, shopping lists, recipe sharing, and smart meal suggestions. Reduce food waste, save money, and discover new recipes!
